_comment: The pages whose text is built from data outside their own file, and that data.
src/lib/content-dates.mjs dates a page by the last commit that changed its content;
a page listed here is also dated by the newest commit to each of its sources, so a
count, a table or a report it renders moves its date the day it changes.
Paths are from the repository root, and one ending in / is a directory.
In "sources", every commit that changed a file counts, except that a directory of
the content tree stands for its pages, each dated by the page rule. "counts" names
each number a page shows of other files after the export that computes it, and
only a commit that changed that number moves the page. A list of git pathspecs is
a number of files, named after its src/data/repo-stats.mjs export; a pathspec that
holds {topic} stands for one per topic the navigation teaches (domainIds in
src/data/topics.mjs, the topics repo-stats.mjs counts the guides under). An object
{"file": path, "lines": pattern} is the number of lines of that file the pattern
matches, named after its src/data/conformance-stats.mjs export: an edit inside an
entry leaves it, a new entry moves it. The build fails on a page or a source HEAD
does not have. site/scripts/content-dates.test.mjs fails on a page that reaches data
without an entry here, on an entry that leaves out a data module or a reader of
the content collection its pages reach, and on a count that is not the number its
export computes. Keys beginning with an underscore are notes to the build; the test
reads "_via", which maps each module the pages reach and are not dated by to the
source that stands for it, or to the reason it moves no page.

entries._why: The landing page states the conformance counts, the release, the catalogue rows and how many guides, API pages and fiches there are. The counts are those the summary banner prints, which make conformance draws from the report and CI holds to it; the report itself also changes with every value and name in it, which the landing page does not show. repo-stats.mjs and conformance-stats.mjs compute the numbers, so every commit to them can change one the page shows: the guides went from 163 to 168 by a change to how repo-stats.mjs picks the topics it counts, with no guide added.

_via.site/src/data/topics.mjs: the icon each area row carries, matched on its link, and the topics the guides are counted under, which counts.guides takes through {topic}, so a topic added with its guides moves the page. A topic added over guides its folder already holds, or a topic that did not teach made one that does, changes the number with no guide added, and that commit moves nothing, since the count reads every commit through the topics of the tree it builds: dating the page by topics.mjs instead would move it with every edit to the navigation, a label, an order or an icon, that changes no number it shows
_via.site/src/generated/api-sidebar.mjs: the API groups topics.mjs builds the sidebar from, none of which the landing page shows

entries._why: The conformance report is the report itself, rendered.
These guides quote the conformance counts, as the summary banner prints them and conformance-stats.mjs reads them.

This guide quotes the conformance counts and the number of errata entries, which conformance-stats.mjs counts as the second-level headings of docs/ERRATA.md. That number is all the page shows of the registry, so a commit that rewraps or corrects an entry leaves the page's date where it is, and one that adds an entry moves it.
The glossary is its data module, rendered.

_via.site/src/components/Glossary.astro: the title of each guide a term links to, printed as the link: a title moves no page's date, its own included, so a guide retitled without a change to glossary.mjs leaves the glossary's date where it is

entries._why: The index of fiches lists every fiche the repository ships.
Each catalogue page renders its tables from the generated catalogue data.

_via.site/src/lib/catalogue-pages.ts: the label, description and catalogue keys of every catalogue page, which the finder and the overview list: a label or a description moves no page's date anywhere on the site, and a catalogue key arrives with its rows in catalogues.mjs, a source
_via.site/src/data/topics.mjs: the order of the catalogue pages (catalogueSlugs), which the finder and the overview follow; a catalogue joins it with its rows in catalogues.mjs, a source
_via.site/src/generated/api-sidebar.mjs: the API groups topics.mjs builds the sidebar from, none of which these pages show
